candidates.rawAssertion: According to the CDC, half of American school children are not fully vaccinated.
At least 1 in 88 toddlers are completely unvaccinated, according to CDC data.
The type of mercury in vaccines, ethylmercury, is claimed to be not harmful to us according to public health authorities.
There have been no credible studies that link vaccination to chronic disease, according to public health authorities.
Vaccines are tested more than any other medicine you could give your kid, according to public health authorities.
In 2016, a documentary film disclosed a decade-long CDC cover-up regarding the MMR vaccine and autism.
William Thompson, a senior CDC scientist, revealed that data linking the MMR vaccine to autism had been manipulated by the CDC.
The CDC ordered William Thompson and other scientists to destroy evidence linking the MMR vaccine to autism.
The fraudulent study released by the CDC declared that it had proven MMR vaccines did not cause autism.
The 1986 National Childhood Vaccine Injury Act removed all liability from drug companies for childhood vaccines they produced.
The childhood vaccination schedule exploded from 25 doses in 1986 to 73 doses by 2011.
In the 1980s, the chronic illness rate in U.S. children jumped to 12.8%, then to 54% by 2011.
The U.S. had twice as many first-day infant deaths as all 27 EU nations combined after implementing an aggressive vaccination program.
An analysis of U.S. data showed that infants who received the most vaccines had the worst hospitalization and death rates.
A 2011 study found that countries giving the least vaccines had the lowest infant mortality rates.
The CDC has never safety tested the cumulative aluminum load received in multiple vaccine shots.
Thimerosal, a mercury-based preservative, has been linked to neurological damage and is still used in some flu shots.
The mercury in multi-dose flu shots preserved with thimerosal is 250 times higher than the limit for mercury in drinking water set by the EPA.
